prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
competitors_mentioned: Five Star Painting of St. Louis/Chesterfield
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company, but based on the available ratings and review volume, **HBP Painting Contractors** is a strong pick for interior painting in St. Louis:

- **5.0 Google rating**
- **Family-owned, insured, and operating since 1983**
- Offers dedicated **interior residential painting**
- PCA member, with an established local track record  
  https://preppaintrepeat.com/interior-house-painters-st-louis/

Two other solid options to compare:

- **S&L Painting** — **4.9/5 across 383+ Google reviews**, PCA- and BBB-accredited  
  https://snlpainting.com/
- **Five Star Painting of St. Louis/Chesterfield** — **4.9/5 from 646 customer reviews**  
  https://www.fivestarpainting.com/st-louis/

My practical recommendation: get written estimates from **HBP**, **S&L**, and **Five Star**, then choose based on prep work included (drywall repair, caulking, sanding), paint brand/number of coats, schedule, and warranty—not price alone.
